description: Create, update and delete instance of Web App.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: always_on
parameters.description: Keeps the app loaded even when there’s no traffic. Choices: false true

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: app_settings
parameters.description: Configure web app application settings. Suboptions are in key value pair format.

parameters.name: app_state
parameters.description: Start/Stop/Restart the web app. Choices: "started" ← (default) "stopped" "restarted"

parameters.name: append_tags
parameters.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object’s metadata. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_affinity_enabled
parameters.description: Whether or not to send session affinity cookies, which route client requests in the same session to the same instance. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: container_settings
parameters.description: Web app container settings.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the container, for example imagename:tag. To create a multi-container app, the name should be ‘COMPOSE|’ or ‘KUBE|’ followed by base64 encoded configuration.

parameters.name: registry_server_password
parameters.description: The container registry server password.

parameters.name: registry_server_url
parameters.description: Container registry server URL, for example mydockerregistry.io.

parameters.name: registry_server_user
parameters.description: The container registry server user name.

parameters.name: deployment_source
parameters.description: Deployment source for git.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: The branch name of the repository.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Repository url of deployment source.

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: frameworks
parameters.description: Set of run time framework settings. Each setting is a dictionary. See https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/app-service-web-overview for more info.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: List of settings of the framework.

parameters.name: java_container
parameters.description: Name of Java container. Supported only when frameworks=java. Sample values Tomcat, JavaSE, RedHat.

parameters.name: java_container_version
parameters.description: Version of Java container. Supported only when frameworks=java. Sample values for Tomcat, 8.5, 9.0, 10.0, 10.1.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version of the framework. For Linux web app supported value, see https://aka.ms/linux-stacks for more info. net_framework supported value sample, v4.8 for .NET 4.8 and v3.5 for .NET 3.5. php supported value sample, 8.1, 8.2. python supported value sample, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12. node supported value sample, 18, 20. dotnetcore supported value sample, 8, 7, 6. ruby supported value sample, 2.3. java supported value sample, 21, 17, 11 and 8.

parameters.name: ftps_state
parameters.description: The state of the FTP/FTPS service. Choices: "AllAllowed" "FtpsOnly" "Disabled"

parameters.name: http20_enabled
parameters.description: Configures a web site to allow clients to connect over HTTP 2.0. Choices: false true

parameters.name: https_only
parameters.description: Configures web site to accept only https requests. Choices: false true

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: Identity for the Object

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of the managed identity Choices: "SystemAssigned" "UserAssigned" "SystemAssigned, UserAssigned" "None" ← (default)

parameters.name: user_assigned_identities
parameters.description: User Assigned Managed Identities and its options Default: {}

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: If the list of identities has to be appended to current identities (true) or if it has to replace current identities (false) Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: List of the user assigned identities IDs associated to the Object Default: []

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Resource location. If not set, location from the resource group will be used as default.

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: min_tls_version
parameters.description: The minimum TLS encryption version required for the app. Choices: "1.0" "1.1" "1.2"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: App service plan. Required for creation. Can be name of existing app service plan in same resource group as web app. Can be the resource ID of an existing app service plan. For example /subscriptions/<subs_id>/resourceGroups/<resource_group>/providers/Microsoft.Web/serverFarms/<plan_name>. Can be a dict containing five parameters, defined below. name, name of app service plan. resource_group, resource group of the app service plan. sku, SKU of app service plan, allowed values listed on https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/app-service/linux/. is_linux, whether or not the app service plan is Linux. defaults to False. number_of_workers, number of workers for app service plan.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: purge_app_settings
parameters.description: Purge any existing application settings. Replace web app application settings with app_settings. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of the resource group to which the resource belongs.

parameters.name: scm_type
parameters.description: Repository type of deployment source, for example LocalGit, GitHub. List of supported values maintained at https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/appservice/webapps/createorupdate#scmtype.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: site_auth_settings
parameters.description: Configuration settings for the Azure App Service Authentication / Authorization feature.

parameters.name: aad_claims_authorization
parameters.description: Gets a JSON string containing the Azure AD Acl settings.

parameters.name: additional_login_params
parameters.description: Login parameters to send to the OpenID Connect authorization endpoint when a user logs in. Each parameter must be in the form “key=value”.

parameters.name: allowed_audiences
parameters.description: Allowed audience values to consider when validating JWTs issued by Azure Active Directory.

parameters.name: allowed_external_redirect_urls
parameters.description: External URLs that can be redirected to as part of logging in or logging out of the app. Note that the query string part of the URL is ignored.

parameters.name: auth_file_path
parameters.description: The path of the config file containing auth settings. If the path is relative, base will the site’s root directory.

parameters.name: client_secret
parameters.description: The Client Secret of this relying party application (in Azure Active Directory, this is also referred to as the Key).

parameters.name: client_secret_certificate_thumbprint
parameters.description: An alternative to the client secret, that is the thumbprint of a certificate used for signing purposes. This property acts as a replacement for the Client Secret. It is also optional.

parameters.name: client_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name that contains the client secret of the relying party application.

parameters.name: config_version
parameters.description: The ConfigVersion of the Authentication / Authorization feature in use for the current app. The setting in this value can control the behavior of the control plane for Authentication / Authorization.

parameters.name: default_provider
parameters.description: The default authentication provider to use when multiple providers are configured. Choices: "AzureActiveDirectory" "Facebook" "Google" "MicrosoftAccount" "Twitter" "Github"

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether enable or disable the Authentication / Authorization feature for the current app. Choices: false true

parameters.name: facebook_app_id
parameters.description: The App ID of the Facebook app used for login.

parameters.name: facebook_app_secret
parameters.description: The App Secret of the Facebook app used for Facebook Login.

parameters.name: facebook_app_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name that contains the app secret used for Facebook Login.

parameters.name: facebook_o_auth_scopes
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 scopes that will be requested as part of Facebook for Facebook Login.

parameters.name: git_hub_client_id
parameters.description: The Client Id of the GitHub app used for login.

parameters.name: git_hub_client_secret
parameters.description: The Client Secret of the GitHub app used for Github Login.

parameters.name: git_hub_client_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name that contains the client secret of the Github app used for GitHub Login.

parameters.name: git_hub_o_auth_scopes
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 scopes that will be requested as part of GitHub Login authentication. This setting is optional.

parameters.name: google_client_id
parameters.description: The OpenID Connect Client ID for the Google web application.

parameters.name: google_client_secret
parameters.description: The client secret associated with the Google web application.

parameters.name: google_client_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name that contains the client secret associated with the Google web application.

parameters.name: google_o_auth_scopes
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 scopes that will be requested as part of Google Sign-In authentication. This setting is optional. If not specified, “openid”, “profile”, and “email” are used as default scopes.

parameters.name: is_auth_from_file
parameters.description: If is_auth_from_file=true, the auth config settings should be read from a file. Choices: "true" "false"

parameters.name: issuer
parameters.description: The OpenID Connect Issuer URI that represents the entity which issues access tokens for this application.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Kind of resource.

parameters.name: microsoft_account_client_id
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 client ID that was created for the app used for authentication. This setting is required for enabling Microsoft Account authentication.

parameters.name: microsoft_account_client_secret
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 client secret that was created for the app used for authentication.

parameters.name: microsoft_account_client_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name containing the OAuth 2.0 client secret that was created for the app used for authentication.

parameters.name: microsoft_account_o_auth_scopes
parameters.description: The OAuth 2.0 scopes that will be requested as part of Microsoft Account authentication.

parameters.name: runtime_version
parameters.description: The RuntimeVersion of the Authentication / Authorization feature in use for the current app.

parameters.name: token_refresh_extension_hours
parameters.description: The number of hours after session token expiration that a session token can be used to call the token refresh API.

parameters.name: token_store_enabled
parameters.description: Whether to use App Service Token Store. Choices: false true

parameters.name: twitter_consumer_key
parameters.description: The OAuth 1.0a consumer key of the Twitter application used for sign-in.

parameters.name: twitter_consumer_secret
parameters.description: The OAuth 1.0a consumer secret of the Twitter application used for sign-in. This setting is required for enabling Twitter Sign-In.

parameters.name: twitter_consumer_secret_setting_name
parameters.description: The app setting name that contains the OAuth 1.0a consumer secret of the Twitter application used for sign-in.

parameters.name: unauthenticated_client_action
parameters.description: The action to take when an unauthenticated client attempts to access the app. Choices: "RedirectToLoginPage" "AllowAnonymous"

parameters.name: startup_file
parameters.description: The web’s startup file. Used only for Linux web apps.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the Web App. Use present to create or update a Web App and absent to delete it. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don’t allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn’t support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Create a windows web app with non-exist app service plan
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myWinWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
      is_linux: false
      sku: S1

- name: Create a docker web app with some app settings, with docker image
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myDockerWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
      is_linux: true
      sku: S1
      number_of_workers: 2
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
      testkey2: testvalue2
    container_settings:
      name: ansible/ansible:ubuntu1404

- name: Create a docker web app with private acr registry
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myDockerWebapp
    plan: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    container_settings:
      name: ansible/ubuntu1404
      registry_server_url: myregistry.io
      registry_server_user: user
      registry_server_password: "{{ password }}"

- name: Create a multi-container web app
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myMultiContainerWebapp
    plan: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    container_settings:
      name: "COMPOSE|{{ lookup('file', 'docker-compose.yml') | b64encode }}"

- name: Create a linux web app with Node 6.6 framework
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myLinuxWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    frameworks:
      - name: "node"
        version: "18"

- name: Create a windows web app with node, php
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myWinWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    frameworks:
      - name: "node"
        version: 18
      - name: "php"
        version: 8.2

- name: Create a stage deployment slot for an existing web app
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myWebapp/slots/stage
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey:testvalue

- name: Create a linux web app with java framework
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myLinuxWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    frameworks:
      - name: "java"
        version: "8"
        settings:
          java_container: "Tomcat"
          java_container_version: "8.5"

- name: Create a windows web app with site_auth_settings
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myWindowWebapp
    site_auth_settings:
      client_id: 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
      default_provider: 'MicrosoftAccount'
      runtime_version: '-2'
      token_refresh_extension_hours: 120
      unauthenticated_client_action: 'RedirectToLoginPage'
      client_secret: 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
      token_store_enabled: false
      enabled: true
      is_auth_from_file: false
    plan:
      resource_group: myResourceGroup
      name: myLinuxwebapp
      is_linux: false
      sku: S1

- name: Create a linux web app with python framework
  azure_rm_webapp:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myLinuxWebapp
    plan:
      resource_group: myAppServicePlan_rg
      name: myAppServicePlan
    app_settings:
      testkey: testvalue
    frameworks:
      - name: "python"
        version: "3.10"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of current web app. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/myWebApp"
